subset: User authorized full dataset 2026-10-03; reuse exact V13 dev20 outputs, execute only frozen complement2282/2570 per model.

pipeline: one global call: candidate first, bounded evidence, actual input-frame anchor, temporal relation
agreement retains native; disagreement with justified uncapped event anchor optionally replays <=12s

revise only if free-generation verifier agrees with candidate; else native
new_generation: greedy seed42; candidate enum A-D followed by evidence <=48 tokens, actual-frame enum or NONE and relation enum; verifier free generation
memory: Candidate-conditioned event ledger used only for proposal and window choice. Verifier receives no candidate/proposal ledger. Valid index is not verified factual localization.
revision: Agreement retains native. Disagreement requires separate evidence compartment verification. Unreadable/truncated proposal or unconfirmed revision retains native.

cost: new cold application-cache work plus reused native recorded seconds; initialization and technical pilot separately; OS cache uncontrolled
technical_pilot: No new algorithm or preprocessing; reuse V13 passed24 pilot and4path probes. No baseline generation. Byte-identical method.py/ledger_grammar.py and all native dependencies verified.
selection: V13 chosen before complement evaluation. No tuning/early stopping by interim accuracy. Report dev20, remaining80, full separately. Prior baseline audits and shared videos mean complement is not a pristine independent holdout.
novelty_status: Hypothesis only: evidence-addressed bounded acquisition plus isolated verification, no established novelty or generalization gain.
stop: one full round then evidence-based next-version review; no blind endless GPU occupation; OOM at most three process attempts per shard, other errors diagnosed
repair: Independent interface repair after V12 label-blind pilot copied numeric metadata into evidence. initial_prompt_metadata: Actual chronological frame addresses only; continuous/sparse/overlap semantics. Exact times and source intervals always stored, provided to local/verifier context.
